definitions.explanation: An aromatic herb (Artemisia indica) that grows wild throughout Japan. Used in cooking, traditional medicine, and cultural practices.

examples.japanese: ヨモギ{餅|もち}を{食|た}べた。
{春|はる}になるとヨモギが{道端|みちばた}に{生|は}えてくる。
examples.english: When spring comes, mugwort grows along the roadsides.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{摘|つ}みたてのヨモギで{草餅|くさもち}を{作|つく}ってくれた。
examples.english: My grandmother made grass mochi for me with freshly picked mugwort.

notes:
USAGE:
A versatile plant deeply connected to Japanese food culture. Most commonly used in {草餅|くさもち} (grass mochi) and ヨモギ{餅|もち} (mugwort mochi), which have a distinctive green color and herbal aroma. Also used in {天|てん}ぷら, tea, and traditional moxibustion therapy ({灸|きゅう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヨモギ{餅|もち} (mugwort mochi)
- {草餅|くさもち} (grass mochi — made with mugwort)
- ヨモギ{茶|ちゃ} (mugwort tea)
- ヨモギを{摘|つ}む (pick mugwort)
- ヨモギ{蒸|む}し (mugwort steam — a spa treatment)

WRITING:
Usually written in katakana. The kanji {蓬|よもぎ} exists but is uncommon in everyday use.
